name: Sabelt
note: Racing seats, seatbelts and racewear maker; Alpine Endurance Team partner for 2026 (club release 19/03/2026). Audi Revolut F1 Team technical partner on the 2026 car; its logo tile is on the team's partners page and Sabelt posted the partnership on 2026-01-27. Sabelt's own history page says Piero and Giorgio Marsiaj founded Sabelt in Turin in 1972, but the page states no current ownership, so no ownership claim was written.
